item.title: Taylor Swift’s ‘Toy Story 5’ Song Will Bring Pop Superstar Back to Country & To Movie Music
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the biggest stories in music. Let's start with the one and only Taylor Swift. She's making a return to country with a brand new song, 'I Knew It, I Knew You', from the upcoming movie Toy Story 5. The song is set to drop this Friday and is inspired by the character Jessie from the Toy Story franchise."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This marks Swift's return to country roots and also brings her back to movie music, following her four Golden Globes nominations for best original song. Meanwhile, on the Billboard charts, Drake is holding strong. His album 'ICEMAN' is spending its second week at number one on the Billboard 200, and his single 'Janice STFU' is also at number one on the Hot 100 for the second week."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Notably, 'ICEMAN' is Drake's sixth album to spend multiple weeks at number one, and 'Janice STFU' is his sixth number one single to spend more than a week at the top spot. It's also his first single to spend multiple weeks at number one since 2018, when 'In My Feelings' spent 10 weeks at number one. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode."
[Outro music plays]
